categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polymer lithium-ion batteries for consumer electronics such as laptops, tablets, smartphones, wearable devices, drones, and electric tools. The company is also expanding into power and energy storage batteries, including automotive low-voltage lithium batteries, industrial drones, electric motorcycles, and home energy storage systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on polymer soft-pack lithium-ion battery technology with proprietary innovations in high-temperature battery technology, digital battery electrolyte technology, high energy density materials, fast-charging materials, and high-safety battery materials. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques such as multi-tab winding, central tab process (CTP), automated production lines, and high-precision stacking. R&D is driven by an integrated product development model emphasizing market demand and rapid iteration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in laptops (HP, Lenovo, Dell, Apple, Asus, Acer, Microsoft, Amazon), smartphones (Apple, Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor, OPPO, Vivo, Lenovo, ZTE), automotive manufacturers (SAIC, IM Motors, GM, Jaguar Land Rover, Li Auto, Chery, GAC, Geely, Stellantis, Mercedes-Benz, NIO), drone manufacturers (DJI), and energy storage providers. The company serves consumer electronics, automotive low-voltage systems, industrial drones, electric motorcycles, and energy storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Zhuhai, Chongqing, Deyang, and Jiaxing, and has established subsidiaries and production facilities in Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, India, Hong Kong, and the United States to support global market expansion and supply chain localization.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhuhai CosMX operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, module and pack assembly, and system integration for end-use applications in consumer electronics, automotive, drones, and energy storage sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with increased R&D investment (12.64% of revenue in 2024). Strategic R&D focuses include high energy density batteries, fast charging, safety enhancements, solid-state lithium metal batteries, automotive low-voltage lithium batteries, and AI-enabled battery development. It collaborates with top universities and research institutes and pursues government-supported projects to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-developed and manufactured lithium-ion battery cells, modules, and packs to major OEM customers in consumer electronics, automotive, and energy storage industries. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhuhai CosMX is a leading global supplier in the consumer lithium-ion battery market, ranking first in laptop battery shipments worldwide and second in tablet batteries, with top-five ranking in smartphone batteries. It competes with major battery manufacturers like ATL and others, maintaining a strong market position through technological innovation, quality, and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 11.54 billion, a 0.83% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 430 million, up 25.03%. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 20.95 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, with a stable growth trajectory and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhuhai CosMX emphasizes high-performance, safe, and reliable polymer lithium-ion batteries with advanced proprietary technologies that enhance energy density, fast charging, and safety. Its comprehensive product portfolio, flexible manufacturing, and strong R&D capabilities enable tailored solutions for diverse applications, supported by long-term partnerships with leading global brands, ensuring competitive differentiation and customer loyalty.
